pageSubtitle: Follow these steps to quickly get started with the complete workflow
alertTitle: Welcome to ODAP Ontology Design System!
alertDescription: This guide will walk you through the complete workflow from workspace setup to data application. Click the steps below to get started.
runTestsHint: Run in command line: pytest tests/unit/ -v
viewCodeHint: See project root for example code
step1Desc: Create or select workspace and scenario
step1Para: Workspace is the base container for all operations. You need to create or select a workspace first, then create scenarios within it.
step1Item1: Log in to the system (default account: admin/admin123)
step1Item2: Select or create a workspace in the top navigation bar
step1Item3: Then select or create a scenario
step1Item4: This is the base container for all subsequent operations
step2Desc: Create entity types, attributes and relations
step2Para: In the ontology designer, you can create entity types, define attributes and establish relations.
step2Item1: Click the add entity type button in the top right
step2Item2: Fill in entity type info: name, display name, description, classification
step2Item3: Add attributes: basic, statistical, capability attributes
step2Item4: Establish relations: associate with other entity types
step2Item5: Save and preview the relation graph
step3Para: In the blueprint designer, you can design business processes using various node types to build data flows.
step4Para: On the object management page, you can view and manage entity instances.
step4Item1: View entity list: table showing all entities
step4Item4: View entity details: grouped by semantic category
step5Para: Finally, you can import data and start applying the knowledge graph.
step5Item4: Auto-extract entities and add to knowledge graph

tour.guideStep1Desc: Click here anytime to restart the guided tour, or view API docs and code examples.
tour.guideStep2Desc: Create or select a workspace and scenario, the foundation for all subsequent operations.
tour.guideStep3Desc: Create entity types, define attributes and establish relations to build the knowledge graph skeleton.
tour.guideStep4Desc: Design business processes using various node types to construct data flows.
tour.guideStep5Desc: Import data and apply the knowledge graph, completing the data-to-knowledge loop.
tour.workspaceStep1Desc: Click this button to create a new workspace, the top-level container for all resources.
tour.workspaceStep2Desc: Switch to the scenario tab to manage business scenarios under this workspace.
tour.workspaceStep3Desc: Create a new scenario in the scenario tab. Scenarios are isolation units for ontologies and data.
tour.ontologyStep1Desc: Click this button to add a new object type and define its attributes and relations.
tour.ontologyStep2Desc: The left list shows all defined object types. Click to edit details.
tour.ontologyStep3Desc: The right panel is used to edit attributes, relations and other details of the selected type.
tour.blueprintStep1Desc: Select the required node types from the node panel and drag them onto the canvas.
tour.blueprintStep2Desc: Drag and connect nodes on the canvas to design business processes.
tour.blueprintStep3Desc: When design is complete, click the run button to execute the blueprint process.
tour.objectMgmtStep1Desc: View and manage all object type definitions in the Type Management tab.
tour.objectMgmtStep2Desc: Switch to the Instances tab to view and manage entity instance data.
tour.objectMgmtStep3Desc: Use filters to filter entity instances by type, source, and status.
tour.ingestStep1Desc: Select the data ingestion method: text, news, JSON, natural language, file upload, etc.
tour.ingestStep2Desc: After entering data, click this button to start the ingestion process.
tour.ingestStep3Desc: The table below shows ingestion history; you can view build details and version information.
